12:31.text: So when she heard of their scheming, she sent for them and prepared for them a banquet and gave each one of them a knife and said
, "Come out before them." And when they saw him, they greatly admired him and cut their hands
This is not a man; this is none but a noble angel."

12:32.text: She said, "That is the one about whom you blamed me. And I certainly sought to seduce him, but he firmly refused; and if he will not do what I order him, he will surely be imprisoned and will be of those debased."

12:33.text: He said, "My Lord, prison is more to my liking than that to which they invite me. And if You do not avert from me their plan, I might incline toward them and

12:34.text: So his Lord responded to him and averted from him their plan. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

12:35.text: Then it appeared to them after they had seen the signs
should surely imprison him for a time.

12:36.text: And there entered the prison with him two young men. One of them said, "Indeed, I have seen myself
wine." The other said, "Indeed, I have seen myself carrying upon my head
bread, from which the birds were eating. Inform us of its interpretation; indeed, we see you to be of those who do good."

12:37.text: He said, "You will not receive food that is provided to you except that I will inform you of its interpretation before it comes to you. That is from what my Lord has taught me. Indeed, I have left the religion of a people who do not believe in Allāh, and they, in the Hereafter, are disbelievers.
